items.text: Bills ruled out DJ Moore (shoulder) for TNF vs Lions after hard landing; was Q to return then OUT. Rapoport confirmed.
items.why: Shoulder + stinger from hard fall; X-rays.
items.implication: Bills WR depth thins for TNF; monitor other options in BUF offense.

items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders. Brock Bowers also DNP again post-knee surgery, yet to practice.
items.implication: Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary; sit McConkey. Bowers fringe/bench.
items.opportunity: McConkey W1 lead receiver; Johnston routes/targets rise.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday, second straight. Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) on IR. If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Aggravated hamstring; Lane IR removes depth.
items.implication: Bateman flex upside if Flowers sits vs Saints; monitor Friday practice.
items.opportunity: Flowers primary; Lane IR opens hierarchy for Bateman et al.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024); DNP Thursday. Routes last week: 37 of 42 Stroud dropbacks. MRI key; status in jeopardy vs Bengals despite not believed serious.
items.why: Hamstring pull history + high route share; doctors don't believe serious per Schefter but jeopardy.
items.implication: If OUT, boost to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel and Schultz TE upside; sit Collins pending Friday.
items.opportunity: 37 routes on 42 dropbacks W1; primary WR1 role at risk.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS despite W1: home 21.3 PPG last yr; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1. DAL top-5 implied total (27), game total 50.5. Smash spot.
TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' after ankle; full practice. Unclear snaps vs Rhamondre Stevenson but returns at ideal time: AJ Brown IR, strong matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV/NYJ etc) before W11 bye.
items.why: Ankle cleared; Pats need explosives with Brown IR.
items.implication: Henderson flex/volatile RB2 upside; Stevenson still RB2 base but share diluted. Upgrade Henderson.
items.opportunity: Explosive role + schedule; Brown absence elevates all skill.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET: 69% routes (highest any 2025 game), 77% snaps (highest since W9 2024). Efficient per-tgt; fully healthy breakout signal. DET allowed 27 TE pts W1.
Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career Wentz games. CHI allowed >10 YPT to CAR WRs W1.
items.why: Elite share + historical Wentz chemistry + soft D.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 W1 (tied Bijan lead). 19% tgt share last 10 games; 25+ touches 3 of last 4. Overreaction to injury scare fading.
items.why: Elite utilization under Kubiak; volume locked.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start @ LAC; buy if discounted.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE W2 vs IND: 24% target share (team lead, 2nd-highest career) W1, 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% targets on routes. IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization + soft IND run D matchup.
items.opportunity: 24% tgt share, high snap/touch share, red-zone implied.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to Jets WRs; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last season.
items.why: Volume + soft secondary matchup after tough W1.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% tgt share W1, 8 more routes than Gainwell, all RB RZ touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC W1. Util RB9.
items.why: Clear lead back + pass/RZ work vs soft run D.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role; NO 8.5-pt underdogs bad script.
Colston Loveland 89% route participation W1 (highest TE); only 2 tgts/0 pts but missed end-zone throw. Buy if owner panics; high-volume TE role confirmed.
items.why: Elite route rate despite low volume/score; Bears offense exploding.
items.implication: Hold/buy low TE; ceiling play ROS.
